sql: SELECT profile, COUNT(*) AS n FROM records GROUP BY profile ORDER BY profile NULLS FIRST
SELECT samples, COUNT(*) AS n FROM records GROUP BY samples ORDER BY samples NULLS FIRST
SELECT items, COUNT(*) AS n FROM records GROUP BY items ORDER BY items NULLS FIRST
SELECT matrix, COUNT(*) AS n FROM records GROUP BY matrix ORDER BY matrix NULLS FIRST
SELECT DISTINCT profile FROM records ORDER BY profile NULLS FIRST
SELECT DISTINCT samples FROM records ORDER BY samples NULLS FIRST
SELECT record_id, key FROM records ORDER BY key NULLS FIRST, record_id LIMIT 25 OFFSET 3
SELECT record_id, samples FROM records ORDER BY samples DESC NULLS FIRST, record_id LIMIT 25 OFFSET 3
SELECT record_id, matrix FROM records ORDER BY matrix NULLS FIRST, record_id LIMIT 25 OFFSET 3
SELECT MIN(profile), MAX(profile), COUNT(profile) FROM records
SELECT MIN(samples), MAX(samples), COUNT(samples) FROM records
SELECT MIN(items), MAX(items), COUNT(items) FROM records

SELECT COUNT(*), COUNT(v.value) FROM records, UNNEST(matrix) AS u LEFT JOIN UNNEST(matrix) AS v ON u.value = v.value

sql: SELECT key, COUNT(*) AS n FROM records GROUP BY key HAVING key = key AND COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY key NULLS FIRST
